sections.title: Oklahoma corporate income and franchise taxes

rows.label: Corporate income tax rate
rows.note: Flat rate on Oklahoma taxable income; same rate in the 2025 Form 512 instructions. No change announced for 2026.

source.title: Oklahoma Tax Commission: Other Taxes (Corporate Income Tax)

rows.label: Corporate franchise tax
rows.value: None from tax year 2024: the franchise tax ($1.25 per $1,000 of capital) was repealed
rows.note: Tax year 2023 was the last franchise tax year (HB 1039X). Foreign corporations still pay a registered agent fee.

sections.title: Oklahoma property tax: state rules

rows.label: Levied by
rows.value: School districts, counties (general, sinking fund, health department), career-tech districts, junior colleges, emergency medical districts and city sinking funds
rows.note: Schools receive the largest share in every county.

source.title: Oklahoma State Auditor & Inspector: Newsletter November/December 2020, Where Do My Property Taxes Go?

rows.label: State oversight
rows.value: Oklahoma Tax Commission, Ad Valorem Division (with the State Board of Equalization)
rows.note: Values public service property and compiles county abstracts certified by the State Board of Equalization.

rows.label: Annual cap on taxable value increases
rows.value: 3% a year for homesteads and agricultural land; 5% for other real property
rows.note: Constitution Art. 10, Sec. 8B; the cap does not apply in a year the property changes hands or for new improvements.

source.title: Oklahoma Tax Commission, Ad Valorem Tax Division: Ad Valorem Statistics 2024

rows.label: Homestead exemption (assessed value)
rows.note: $1,000 of assessed (not market) value; an additional $1,000 applies for qualifying lower-income heads of household (68 O.S. 2889, 2890).

sections.title: Oklahoma real estate transfer tax

rows.label: Documentary stamp tax on deeds
rows.value: $0.75 per $500 of consideration (or fraction), when consideration exceeds $100
rows.note: Equivalent to 0.15%. Applies to deeds conveying realty that is sold; stamps are sold by the county clerk.

source.title: Oklahoma Tax Commission: Documentary Stamp Tax Quick Reference Guide (2021), quoting 68 O.S. 3201

rows.label: Who pays
rows.value: Either the buyer (grantee) or the seller (grantor)
rows.note: The rule does not assign it to one party; it is usually settled in the sale contract.

source.title: Oklahoma Tax Commission: Documentary Stamp Tax Quick Reference Guide (2021), quoting OAC 710:30-1-8

rows.label: County share
rows.value: Counties keep 30.33% of documentary stamp receipts; the rest goes to the Oklahoma Tax Commission
rows.note: From the county clerk's monthly return form.
